question: 某人吃了200g第四行的第二列的食物，50g第三行的第三列的食物，100g第二行的第三列的食物，那么他摄入了多少热量？

steps.description: Locate the food item at row 4, column 2 in the table and read its calorie value
Multiply 200g by the calorie value per 100g from step_1 to calculate calories from pork belly
Locate the food item at row 3, column 3 in the table and read its calorie value
Multiply 50g by the calorie value per 100g from step_3 to calculate calories from rabbit meat
Locate the food item at row 2, column 3 in the table and read its calorie value
Multiply 100g by the calorie value per 100g from step_5 to calculate calories from duck meat
Sum the calorie values from step_2, step_4, and step_6 to get total calories
Round the total calorie value from step_7 to two decimal places
